import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/djc/projects/GeoPhy-Set3D/scripts/geometry_utilization_v1')
from diagnostic import BASE,HERE,scheduler
old=scheduler()
original_write=old.write
def isolated_write(path,value):
    if Path(path)==BASE/'status.json':
        path=BASE/'scheduling'/'parallel_layout09_status.json'
    return original_write(path,value)
old.write=isolated_write
old.progress=lambda:None
old.run_gpu_once('predict_layout09',[sys.executable,str(HERE/'diagnostic.py'),'predict','--layout-index','09'],BASE/'predictions'/'layout09'/'complete.json')
